analysis_notes.summary: Ross highlights Lions O-line injuries (Mahogany, Miller, Scruggs) and missing safeties (Joseph, Branch on IR) making this a tough road spot against Buffalo.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: I don't know if their left guard Christian Mahogany will play... Blake Miller... Kirby Joseph and Brian Branch are both on IR for the Lions.

analysis_notes.summary: Ross projects Vikings sit Kyler Murray another week, starting Carson Wentz. He expects Brian Flores' defense to confuse Caleb Williams but thinks the Bears win a close one.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: I think the Vikings will err on the side of caution and give Kyler Murray an extra week... which would mean it's a Carson Wentz game.

analysis_notes.summary: Ross notes Texans must get interior pressure on Joe Burrow and win matchups inside so they don't give Burrow too much time.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: The Texans have to get pressure on Joe Burrow... they need to win their inside matchups.

analysis_notes.summary: Producer Jack and Ross review roster changes: Browns place Dylan Samson on IR, Panthers cut returner Jimmy Horn Jr., Cowboys sign Tyler Goodson, and Jaguars sign BJ Ojulari.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: It's a shame about Samson because I think he's a heck of a third down back.

analysis_notes.summary: With Henry To'oTo'o landing on IR, the Texans' already-thin linebacker depth is tested, leading to the signing of Kenneth Murray.
analysis_notes.speaker: Ross Tucker
analysis_notes.quote: Their depth at linebacker was already a little dicey in my mind.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Ross Tucker
quote_timestamps.quote: For Thursday night, can't wait to see the new stadium... but I think it will be the Buffalo Bills.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Ross Tucker
quote_timestamps.quote: So, I'm going to go 27-24, the Bears get this win.
